messages.subject: Integrated distance sampling models
parts:
Dear all,

 

FYI, we just uploaded the pre-print of a paper in which we develop what we call integrated distance sampling, or IDS, models: https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.17229.

 

IDS models combine proper distance sampling data with distance-free point count or detection/nondetection data and enable estimation of a latent detection function for the distance-free data types. This achieves a reconciliation of the spatial mismatch between these data types. We also show how with extra-information (such as variable survey duration) one can estimate the parameters of an availability process. This then addresses the temporal mismatch that typically exists when one tries to combine such data from different surveys. To fit these models, we provide JAGS code and a new IDS() function in unmarked.

 

Best regards  -- Marc
